connector.name: Margin of Insight - Equity Research
connector.registryDescription: Equity research API for US-listed companies. Free primer, $1 fundamentals, $2 investment memo.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.marginofinsight.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.marginofinsight, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Stripe Shared Payment Token for paid tools (get_fundamental_analysis, get_investment_memo). Format: `Bearer spt_…`. Free tools (get_company_primer, list_coverage, search_research, request_coverage) require no header. See https://docs.stripe.com/agentic-commerce/concepts/shared-payment-tokens and https://app.marginofinsight.com/api/v1/well-known/spt.
